context.body: Jesus, Spirit, and heavenly voice are distinguished in one brief event.
context.label: Narrative or literary frame

observations.body: Jesus is baptized, heaven opens, God’s Spirit descends, and a heavenly voice names the beloved Son and delight.
observations.label: Father, Son, and Spirit appear at baptism: action

observations.body: John objects and then consents; Jesus comes out of the water and receives the signs.
observations.label: Father, Son, and Spirit appear at baptism: response

observations.body: Spirit of God · my beloved Son · well pleased
observations.label: Words in Matthew 3:13–17

payload.posture: Read Matthew 3:13–17 as jesus names the father evidence before carrying it into another source.
payload.tension: The scene displays relation among Father, Son, and Spirit without offering a later doctrinal formula.
payload.title: Father, Son, and Spirit appear at baptism
